choice_rule: Maximize source-, raw-input-, and provisional-origin-parent-disjoint coverage at six options per populated cell; break equal-cardinality choices by the frozen hash rank. For PIXEL_SUPPORTED options use verified resolved parents instead of the provisional origin parent.
replacement_rule: After assessing the selected options, stop while any remains PENDING. Keep every PIXEL_SUPPORTED selection fixed. Replace only selected options with terminal PIXEL_UNSUPPORTED evidence, optimizing among remaining input options. If supported selections conflict on resolved parent, fail explicitly; never silently replace one. Repeat until all selected options are supported or full capacity is impossible.
claim_boundary: The 210 choices stage pixel-input assessment across 35 populated cells. The declared 36th-cell gap remains, and this is not the balanced 216-trial cohort or the independent 300-planet release gate. No detector, vetter, localization, or sealed evaluation outcome may inform selection.
